top_signals.title: Cyclospora Outbreak Sends Shivers Through Restaurant Stocks
top_signals.summary: The cyclospora outbreak in the US tied to lettuce used in restaurants has made more than 10,000 people sick according to the Centers for Disease Control. This has caused fewer people to go out to eat or get fast food. Now this is starting to hurt the restaurant sector. R.J. Hottovy of Placer.AI research covers the space and joins "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
